name: Airship deck
desc: the open deck of a flying ship in transit, for crossings, watches and boarding actions
tags: wooden airship deck, rigging ropes and rope ladders, taut canvas gasbag overhead, brass railing, ship wheel, mooring lines, cloud tops below the rail, open sky, pennants snapping in the wind
prose: the wooden deck of an airship, rigging and rope ladders running up to the great canvas gasbag overhead, a brass rail and ship's wheel, pennants snapping in the wind and cloud tops passing below the rail
note: Left alone this is a sailing ship at sea. Two nouns fix it and you need both: the gasbag or envelope visibly OVERHEAD in frame, and cloud below the rail where the water would be. The rigging can stay nautical - it is the thing above and the thing below that put the deck in the air.
